llmJudgeRequirements.description: Submit flow is implemented as a writable async Jotai atom action
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: submitPostAtom is defined with atom(null, async (get, set) => {...}), making it a writable async Jotai atom action.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Screen state includes separate atoms for draft text posts list and submit lifecycle
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Separate atoms exist for draft text (draftAtom), the posts list (postsAtom), and submit lifecycle (submitStateAtom).
evidence: const submitStateAtom = atom<SubmitState>({ error: null, status: 'idle' })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Submit action writes pending then commits success or error lifecycle state
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: submitPostAtom sets status 'submitting' before the fetch, 'success' on resolution, and 'error' in the catch block.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Successful mutation appends or prepends created post data and clears draft input atom
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: On success, the created post is prepended to postsAtom and draftAtom is reset to an empty string.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Submit button triggers the async write atom through `useSetAtom` or `useAtom` dispatch
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The component uses useAtom(submitPostAtom) to obtain the dispatch function and passes it directly to the Pressable onPress handler.
